title: Cardinal Select Shop Network Guide: Scheduling Recalibration Alongside Repairs
content:
Under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, the days an accepted larger-class partner rental is authorized for rest on its repair days. The repair days combine the rental's starting days and its recalibration days. How they combine depends on the kind of shop doing the work, which is the shop that wrote the latest estimate on the Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage claim.

## Scheduling by kind of shop

| Shop that wrote the latest estimate | How the work is scheduled | Repair days |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Select Shop | Recalibrates in house while it repairs, so recalibration runs alongside the repair | The larger of the starting days and the recalibration days |
| Shop outside the Select network | Sublets recalibration to a dealer after the repair | The starting days, plus the recalibration days, plus 1 day for moving the vehicle to the dealer and back |
| No shop kind recorded on an estimate | — | The starting days plus the recalibration days |

The 1 transfer day at a shop outside the Select network is part of that shop's schedule. It is added whatever number of recalibration days is owed.

## Worked schedules (hypothetical day counts)

| Shop | Starting days | Recalibration days | Repair days |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Select Shop | 4 | 2 | 4 (the larger of 4 and 2) |
| Cardinal Select Shop | 1 | 2 | 2 (the larger of 1 and 2) |
| Shop outside the Select network | 2 | 2 | 5 (2 plus 2 plus 1) |
| Shop outside the Select network | 2 | 0 | 3 (2 plus 0 plus 1) |
| No shop kind recorded | 7 | 1 | 8 (7 plus 1) |
